notes.title: Nomad Idle 1.1 - The Big Rebalance Update
notes.notes:
There was a controversial slider in the Settings menu that, after talking it over with some of the community in the Discord, I have decided to remove. I was wanting to remove it because it's causing problems, but was unsure about moving forward with it. Today, it's happening.

There was a slider in the Settings menu where you could adjust the number of concurrent enemies from 100 to 300. It warned of performance issues, but I was getting a lot of complaints about single-digit FPS from players and whenever I asked them about this, they always had 300 enemies.

Balance is also impossible. On-kill effects become way stronger because more enemies means more enemies dying and procing their effect all over the place. They would forever be overpowered. All the meanwhile the game would be lagging to pieces and overall it was a mistake to allow this slider to exist.

In order to make this an easier transition, all Equipment of Tier 4 and higher has had its Material requirement reduced by 30%, so that hopefully upgrading equipment is less of a huge grind. Ore and Cloth requirements specifically are reduced by 50% instead.

Bestiary requirements also no longer ramp up, staying consistent across Areas with the same kill count requirements as Area 1.

Enemies starting in Area 8 have had their health reduced. In my testing, Area 7 felt fine, but starting at Area 8, enemies started to feel very spongey for no good reason.

Quick note, if Equipment requires Tier 4 Materials, it's deemed internally as Tier 4 Equipment. That's what I'm referring to when I mention Equipment tiers.

Here's general patch notes:

- Mysterious Stranger V coin requirement reduced by 1/50
- Enemy health Areas 8, 9, 10 reduced by 50%
- Equipment material requirements for Tiers 4 and 5 reduced by 30%, 50% if it's Ore or Cloth.
- Tier 5 Material cost has been lowered further to be similar to Tier 4 Equipment cost.
- Equipment obtained from Objectives for Tiers 4 and 5 have had their Material counts further reduced by roughly 50%.
- Bestiary requirements no longer ramp up and stay static at values that were present in Area 1.
- Removed Enemy count slider in the Settings menu. For those that were using it, all of the above changes should make up for it. For those that were not, this should help with grind concerns.

notes.title: Upcoming Balance Patch
notes.notes:
I've been working on a big balance patch. I'm going through the game, start to finish, testing every skill as I get them, and then testing them again a couple Areas later. I've been seeing the concerns about the games current balance, so I wanted to announce that I'm working on this.

It's clear that despite my best efforts, I've missed the mark on balancing Nomad Idle in a way that's fun and interesting. Moreover, some aspects ended up being a bit more grindy than I originally anticipated. This patch I'm working on should be done in the next day or two, but for sake of some reassurance that I'm listening to feedback, here's an outline of some of the things coming up:

- Bestiary requirements will no longer ramp up, staying consistent across Areas with the same kill count requirements as Area 1. Area 1's kill requirement seemed to be a comfortable spot, so I'll apply that same criteria to all Areas.

- Material requirements for Equipment will be reduced, starting at Tier 3, by 30%. Ore and Cloth specifically were accidentally made more scarce than other Materials. This was totally unintentional, so their requirements will be decreased by 50% instead.

- Massive balance overhaul. I want to make many skills more useful, especially Characters. Right now it seems like Characters don't quite have an identity because a lot of what they do doesn't really contribute to your total DPS. This will be looked at, as well as Summons, Trinkets, DoTs, and more.

- This is going to involve a few nerfs but A LOT of buffs, some of which are rather significant.

I look forward to finishing this patch up and sending it out to everyone. I appreciate all of the feedback. As of today, Nomad Idle has been released for 4 days, so I'm trying my best to stay on top of this stuff, but at the end of the day, I am a solo dev doing my best.

One thing I want you to hopefully understand is that no matter what I do, there will be builds that aren't great and builds that are "the best". I can't achieve perfect balance, but it can certainly be better than what it is right now.

Thank you, and stay awesome.

notes.title: New Release Date - April 4th
notes.notes:
Hello! Hope everyone is doing well.

I've needed to push the release date for Nomad Idle back, but fortunately only by one week. Instead of it releasing on March 28th, it will now release on [i][b]April 4th[/b][/i].

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.6.3b
notes.notes:
- DPS/MPS Log now updates faster when resetting it.
- Fixed: When dying, there were some specific situations where the game would crash.
- Fixed: Hedgehog Summon incorrectly contributing to damage dealt for all skills.
- Fixed: Clicking bags is supposed to give you the material of the next Area, but was accidentally giving you the material of the current Area.
- Fixed: Skills would sometimes stop working after dying. This was a rare bug.
- Fixed: DPS/MPS Log buttons could be interacted with behind menus.
- Fixed: Spooky enemy ghost issue.
- Fixed: Display Overkill Damage in the DPS/MPS Log was behaving incorrectly.
- Fixed: Number abbreviations would sometimes be culled incorrectly.

notes.title: NextFest Demo Update
notes.notes:
Nomad Idle will be participating in the upcoming [b]Steam NextFest[/b]. I've decided to pre-emptively upload the NextFest build today.

This update contains a lot of optimizations and a balance overhaul. [i]It does not have new content from the previous demo[/i], so if you're already completed all there is to offer in the demo, then you won't have much reason to return yet.

You can expect the game to fully release on March 28th! You can be reminded by wishlisting the game, if you haven't done so already.

Thanks!

EDIT: Based on feedback, I've done another balance pass on damage and mana cost scaling to make it less abrupt.

notes.title: Patch 0.6.0a
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Summon's "Insight" Autocast chance increased. 0.5% -> 1%
[*] Removed various text effects from the Chinese, Korean, and Japanese languages.
[*] Fixed: More text issues.
[*] Fixed: DoT effects would sometimes persist on enemies after their defeat.
[*] Fixed: Summon's "Insight" autocasting of your LMB skill was frequently being used on enemies that were already killed. It has been redesigned to be used on the enemy nearest to the player. The description has also been updated to clarify when it's used.
[*] Fixed: Soft locks with certain Events when using the Korean Language.
[/list]

notes.title: Many Bugfixes - Where are the patch notes?
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone.

First, a big thank you for everyone that's checked out the game. The reception has been way bigger and way more supportive than I ever could've imagined.

You might've noticed that the game seems to be getting updates every day, sometimes multiple times, but there's no patch notes. I'm pretty much just fixing bugs as they come up over in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/779FCkeeWT]Discord[/url] server and didn't want to clutter up your timeline with one or two lines of miscellanous bug fixes.

You can expect actual new content in the Demo. I'm not entirely sure when the Demo will be ready, but I'll make an announcement when it's getting close. [b]Your save progress will transfer over.[/b]

Thank you.

notes.title: Playtest Hotfix 2
notes.notes:
The latest version is 0.5.9e and contains a lot of bug fixes. Sorry about the hassle! I did a pretty big optimization change and it broke a lot of stuff I didn't anticipate breaking.

If you're not updated, I strongly urge you to close the game and let it update.

Thank you for checking the game out!

notes.title: Playtest Hotfix 1
notes.notes:
Sorry for the rocky launch! I think I've fixed all of the reported bugs that were made over on our Discord. Thank you so much for checking the game out and for your patience. You should be on Version 0.5.9c now (shown in the title screen to the top-left).

Let me know if you encounter any more problems!
